narrative:
Three-statement model for VITREA Group from one chart of accounts. FY2025 actuals: revenue EUR 1.15B, cost of care EUR 892M (77.5%), EBITDA EUR 115M (10.0%). The FY2027 plan reaches EUR 1.27B revenue and EUR 130M EBITDA.

The balance sheet combines payer receivables from DRV, GKV, Austrian social insurance and Swiss insurers with a property-heavy clinic estate and the goodwill from clinic acquisitions. Swiss clinics are translated from CHF.

Planning figures are a synthetic model calibrated for this demonstration, not VITREA reported results.

signals.title: Carve-out completed — PAI Partners 67%, Fresenius 33%
signals.excerpt: The former Vamed rehabilitation business operates as VITREA, owned 67% by PAI Partners and 33% by Fresenius; standalone functions replace transitional services.
